changeSet.author: opsx
changeSet.comment: Normalize all role values to MEMBER
changeSet.sql: UPDATE business_user SET role = 'MEMBER' WHERE role IS NULL OR role <> 'MEMBER';
UPDATE business_invitation SET role = 'MEMBER' WHERE role IS NULL OR role <> 'MEMBER';

changeSet.author: opsx
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE business_user ADD CONSTRAINT ck_business_user_role_member_only CHECK (role = 'MEMBER');

changeSet.author: opsx
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE business_invitation ADD CONSTRAINT ck_business_invitation_role_member_only CHECK (role = 'MEMBER');
